title: Axiomatic Choice and the Decision-Evaluation Paradox
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It introduces a theoretical framework for modeling decisions with axioms.
findings: The paper's findings are related to a theoretical concept called the 'Decision-Evaluation Paradox' in axiomatic systems for AI alignment and social choice. It does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
